nom: Borghese Effetto Immediato Spa Soothing Tonic

segments.dry: Reviewers who describe dry or aging skin report the tonic relieves winter or age-related dryness without stripping the skin, though one long-time user notes a sticky finish since the reformulation.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers identifying as sensitive or redness-prone report the toner is calming and non-irritating, with no burning, stinging, or increased redness.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin says the discontinued Tonico Minerale formula suited her skin well and finds the current version a weaker, overpriced substitute.
segments.mature: Long-time users who describe themselves as older (70s, 80s, 90s) credit decades of use with soft, unwrinkled, compliment-worthy skin and use the tonic as a basic step in an anti-aging routine.
segments.oily: One reviewer mentions using the product on her husband's oily scalp/head with good results, though this is not framed as facial oily-skin feedback.

concerns.aging: Several long-term users, mostly older, report smoother, less-wrinkled skin and fewer signs of aging attributed to regular use over decades; one reviewer specifically notes softened lines around the eyes within two days.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the toner hydrates and relieves dryness without stripping the skin, including one who calls it effective for age-related dryness; one dissenting reviewer says the reformulated version now feels sticky.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness-prone or reactive skin report the tonic calms their skin with no irritation or increased redness, including one who says other toners caused redness but this one did not.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the tonic as gentle, non-stinging, and non-burning, suggesting it does not compromise the skin barrier for sensitive users.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports that post-breakout red spots and scarring almost fully faded after regular use combined with a clay mask; this is a single, notably strong result not echoed elsewhere.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer uses the tonic directly on blemishes and cuts as a spot treatment, describing it as effective, though this is an isolated use case.
concerns.oiliness: Feedback on oiliness is minimal; one reviewer notes her husband uses it on his oily scalp, and another says it does not strip natural oils, but no oily-skin-specific complaints or benefits are widely reported.

aspects.libelle: Light spa fragrance despite fragrance-free label
Good value versus discontinued original formula

extraits.texte: As I've gotten older I've started getting bad scarring from random breakouts; they would leave behind bright red spots on my skin that I couldn't get rid of no matter what I tried. Recently I've started using the Fango Uniforme mask twice a week, and this toner every morning and every night after I wash my face and the spots are almost 100% gone. I am so, SO pleased with the results and recommend it to everyone I know with the same skin concerns!

extraits.titre: Only toner that works for me
extraits.texte: I have very difficult skin with a tendency to redness. I do pour this into a clean empty spray bottle for application, but my face has never looked better. Clean, soft, no redness or irritation.

I love this product so much, it's pure perfection for my skin! I stopped using toners about a year ago because they were irritating causing redness + drying- thought I'd give it go again and I am so happy I did!! My face is glowing five stars!

extraits.titre: Nothing like the discontinued Tonico Minerale
extraits.texte: I used the now discontinued Tonico Minerale for years and it was perfect for my combination skin. This product is an overpriced, wimpy alternative, so I was forced to switch to another brand.
DUE TO MY AGE MY FACE IS DRY. THAT TONER WORKED VERY EFFECTIVELY FOR ME. I am very pleased with the outcome.

I love this toner its very cool and soothing on my sensitive skin. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and hydrated. I always use after I cleanse to restore a healthy glow and to reduce that tignt feeling.

extraits.titre: Sad and disappointed ... this WAS a great product.
extraits.texte: I have loved this product for decades. Now the SCENT is RADICALLY different, and I dislike it immensely. After drying on my face, it feels STICKY. I give credit to your products for keeping my facial skin soft and supple, but I'll be looking for a different toner after this bottle is empty. So very sad why did you change the formulation? PUT IT BACK, and bring back the SCENT with it!
